reason: The frozen protocol called each root-process pair an analysis unit, but the three processes reuse the same 12 frozen roots. Process runs are technical timing repeats, not independent experimental roots.
aggregation: For each method and root, take the median of the three process-level root medians. For delta, first add one fortieth of that process/root root-certificate time. Compute the point estimate as the ratio of method medians across the 12 aggregated roots.
interval: Paired percentile bootstrap over 12 root clusters with 10000 resamples; all methods and technical repeats for one root remain together.
reporting_boundary: Report n=12 independent roots per cell and three technical timing repeats. Do not report n=36 independent samples. Preserve the original frozen protocol verbatim and record this as a pre-summary analysis correction.
